## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience. It is not ready to publish as written.

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website" | On the policy list. Passes. |
| "The finest" | Unproven superlative. Remove it. |
| "organic loose leaf" | Supported by "certified organic by the Soil Association". Passes, but naming the certifier is stronger. |
| "eco-friendly bags" | Vague green claim, not on the policy list. Replace it with the provable wording: plastic-free and home compostable. |
| "packed by hand in Bristol" | The policy covers tins ("every tin is packed by hand in Bristol"). The sentence reads as though the bags are hand-packed too, so tie it to tins. |

**Regulated claims:** "eco-friendly" is the broad environmental claim regulators challenge most (the UK CMA Green Claims Code). The policy's specific wording avoids the problem.

**House style:** "The finest" is empty puffery and a mild AI tell. The rewrite below is plainer and more specific.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own landing page, with no sponsor, affiliate link, creator or AI-generated imagery described. No label is needed.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite):**
> Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic loose leaf tea and plastic-free, home compostable tea bags. Every tin packed by hand in Bristol.

**Needs a decision:**
- Confirm the hero should say "Certified organic by the Soil Association" or just "certified organic". Both are on the policy list. I suggest naming the Soil Association if the logo can be shown.
- Confirm that the review rating is current. If the policy row is past its review date, treat it as unproven.

**Approver:** The policy names no approver, so I need an explicit yes from you on the final text above. I haven't recorded any approval, and nothing should be published until you give it.

**Evidence log rows (for pasting):**
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | 4.8/5 from over 1,200 reviews on website | Policy list | Brand policy
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | Certified organic | Policy list | Brand policy (Soil Association)
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | Plastic-free, home compostable tea bags | Policy list | Brand policy
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | Every tin packed by hand in Bristol | Policy list | Brand policy
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | "The finest" | Removed, unproven | n/a
- 2026-11-17 | Landing hero | "eco-friendly bags" | Replaced with specific policy wording | n/a
